scope: Read-only discovery and identification of the Wemo on the user's LAN

read_only_requests.ssdp: Two M-SEARCH discovery requests scoped to Belkin controllee/basicevent services
read_only_requests.soap_note: UPnP uses HTTP POST even for read-only getters. Only the four explicitly listed metadata getters were invoked, with no input arguments; no control/set/update actions were invoked.
read_only_requests.mdns: Six-second browse/resolve of _hap._tcp.local via macOS dns-sd

observed_limits.retail_part_number: F7C063 not present in the inspected live identity/metadata responses; Mini family is confirmed, exact retail variant remains inferred
observed_limits.bootloader: No bootloader version returned by the inspected responses, and no explicitly named bootloader-version action in the 10 advertised service descriptors
observed_limits.uninterpreted_metadata: Opaque ExtMetaInfo fields were not assumed to identify a bootloader
observed_limits.not_proof_of_impossibility: Other authenticated or physical access methods may exist; none is established or attempted here

intentionally_not_used: GetManufactureData: older source binary includes a CreateManufactureData path that writes /tmp/Belkin_settings/ManufactureData.xml; getter side effects not ruled out
Log generation/export, debug/test actions, credential getters, pairing, SSH/Telnet login, command execution and exploitation
Relay controls, Wi-Fi/setup changes, reboots/resets, environment writes, firmware uploads/updates and flash operations
private_evidence: Raw XML and discovery responses stay in ignored artifacts/local-network with private file permissions; addresses, serials, MACs, names and setup information are omitted from committed evidence
conclusion: Network checks confirm Wemo Mini v2 / SNSV2 family but do not establish exact retail part number or bootloader. Installation and recovery remain unverified.
